summary: fix(tests): remove act() warnings in settings and react unit tests
description:
## Because

- Unit runs printed 42 "not wrapped in act(...)" warnings: 18 from fxa-react `AppLocalizationProvider`, 12 from `ConnectThisDevice`, 9 from `SigninPasswordlessCode`, 2 from `NimbusContext` and 1 from `ScanQR`.
- The warnings came from async test timing. They hid real warnings in the test output.

## This pull request

- `AppLocalizationProvider.test.tsx`: uses `waitFor` from Testing Library in place of `async-wait-until`.
- `ConnectThisDevice/container.test.tsx`: wraps `emitState` in `act`.
- `ScanQR/container.test.tsx` and `NimbusContext.test.tsx`: each awaits the settled state at the end of one test.
- `SigninPasswordlessCode/container.test.tsx`: renders inside `await act(async)`.
- This change touches test files only. No source file changes.

## Issue that this pull request solves

Fixes FXA-14662
